title: eulophia antennisepala
intro: Eulophia antennisepala, commonly known as the Tongue Orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is traditionally used in African and Asian folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Eulophia antennisepala are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may be beneficial in managing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
